citations.claim: EW yellow active at step 202, 2s into truncated yellow
EW yellow still active at step 204, last yellow second before red
first violating step: EW turned red after only 3s yellow instead of required 5s

counterfactual.change: Set actuated false (fixed-time); full 5s yellow is held and violation disappears, implicating actuated gap-out logic truncating yellow.

explanation: Actuated controller truncates yellow: EW yellow spans only steps 202-204 (3s) then all-red at 205, though yellow_seconds=5. With actuated=false the same timings pass, so the actuated early-termination/gap logic appears to cut the yellow short (by 2s) instead of only applying to green.
vision_note: The EW approaches show yellow in steps 202, 203 and 204, then all approaches are red at step 205. The yellow lasts only three seconds before turning red instead of holding for the required five seconds.
